would_have_shipped_defects.summary: The launch gate refuses an order carrying the declared-unpredicted disposition, crossing the order's stop-line that a deliberately unpredicted order must never need `--anyway`.
would_have_shipped_defects.why_blocking: The gate's only condition is `section present AND 0 fields parsed` — which is exactly the shape of the protocol's one-line declared-unpredicted disposition. The operator launching a deliberately unpredicted order is refused at the gate and forced to reach for `--anyway`, the escape hatch reserved for a genuinely broken section. The code's own comment claims this case is allowed; nothing implements it. This fires the first time any wave launches a declared-unpredicted order, and it is the failure mode the order named as a risk ("a launch refusal blocking a legitimate unpredicted order").
